name: call2me
description: Give your AI assistant a real phone line: place calls with AI voice agents, read transcripts, run a live two-way interpreter in 31 languages, and buy phone numbers.

interface.shortDescription: Real phone calls and a live interpreter
interface.longDescription: Give your AI assistant a real phone line: place calls with AI voice agents, read transcripts, run a live two-way interpreter in 31 languages, and buy phone numbers. Sign in with Call2Me on first use (OAuth); the model never sees your API key.
